`recorded-extraction-cra-subset.json`: deterministic subset of `curated-content/CRA-1.0/baseline.json` (same raw `nodes`/`edges` shape): the first 3 Role nodes by id, their Requirements (`role_id`), HAS Obligations, REQUIRES Capabilities and every DEFINES/EXPRESSES/HAS/SATISFIED_BY/REQUIRES edge among them; the RegulatoryInstrument node and all `embedding` properties are dropped (the Domain Mapper writer is never given them); nodes sorted by (label, id), edges by (type, source, target). Regenerate by re-applying that filter to the artifact (no generator is committed). Used by `test_persist_equivalence.py`.
